guard: A restore holds the chat stream at the recorded count and no age through every check of the restored state, then sets the age the backup recorded on the target and reads it back; a `cotal up` that fails after moving the chat stream's limit says so in its error and envelope, and `cotal setup --start`, whose start runs in a child process, reports the move in its own receipt whether the start then fails or goes on.
command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/cli build && pnpm smoke:chat-history-restore:live
why: The suite drives `tsx bin/cotal.ts`, which loads core and the CLI from their built dist, so each mutation
rebuilds both and `afterRestore` rebuilds them from the restored source. The first scenario's posts are older
than the recorded age when the restore checks them, so a restore that set the age first would watch the broker
delete them during its own checks.

mutations.name: the restore stages the chat stream at the recorded age
mutations.expectRed: a restore whose posts are older than the recorded age passes its checks
mutations.cell: a restore whose posts are older than the recorded age passes its checks

mutations.name: the restore never sets the recorded age
mutations.find: if (chatRecord && wanted.includes(chatRecord.stream)) await applyRecordedChatAge(broker, journal.space, chatRecord);
mutations.expectRed: ...then holds the recorded age and count
mutations.cell: ...then holds the recorded age and count

mutations.name: a start that fails after the move does not say the limit moved
mutations.expectRed: a start that moves the limit and then fails on a later step says the limit moved
mutations.cell: a start that moves the limit and then fails on a later step says the limit moved
mutations.note: The broker deleted the posts older than the new age at the move, and the next start finds nothing to move, so this error is the only report of it.

mutations.name: setup's child does not report a move before its failure
mutations.expectRed: a setup whose start moves the limit and then fails says the limit moved
mutations.cell: a setup whose start moves the limit and then fails says the limit moved
mutations.note: Setup reads none of its startup child's output, so this message is the only way the move reaches setup's receipt.

mutations.name: setup's child does not report a move when its start returns
mutations.expectRed: a setup whose start moves the limit and goes on warns that the limit moved
mutations.cell: a setup whose start moves the limit and goes on warns that the limit moved

mutations.name: setup drops the child's move from a startup failure
mutations.find: const failed = (error: CommandFailure) => moved ? chatHistoryMovedFailure(error, { space, change: moved }) : error;
mutations.expectRed: a setup whose start moves the limit and then fails says the limit moved
mutations.cell: a setup whose start moves the limit and then fails says the limit moved

mutations.name: setup does not warn about a move its start reported
mutations.find: warnings.push({ code: "CHAT_HISTORY_MIGRATED", target: { root: inputs.project, space: inputs.space, stream: moved.stream }, message: chatHistoryMigratedNotice(inputs.space, moved) });
mutations.expectRed: a setup whose start moves the limit and goes on warns that the limit moved
mutations.cell: a setup whose start moves the limit and goes on warns that the limit moved

mutations.name: setup leaves the move out of its changed list
mutations.expectRed: ...and setup's envelope names the chat stream as changed
mutations.cell: ...and setup's envelope names the chat stream as changed

mutations.name: setup refuses a failure receipt that follows a move
mutations.find: if (!parsed.success || receipt || parsed.data.root !== root || parsed.data.space !== space || parsed.data.pid !== child.pid) invalidReceipt = true;
mutations.replace: if (!parsed.success || receipt || moved !== undefined || parsed.data.root !== root || parsed.data.space !== space || parsed.data.pid !== child.pid) invalidReceipt = true;
mutations.expectRed: a setup whose start moves the limit and then fails says the limit moved
mutations.cell: a setup whose start moves the limit and then fails says the limit moved
mutations.note: The move comes first on the failure path, so the receipt after it must still be read as the classified result.

mutations.name: an unreadable manager identity escapes the move
mutations.expectRed: a setup whose manager identity does not read after the move says the limit moved
mutations.cell: a setup whose manager identity does not read after the move says the limit moved
mutations.note: The read throws a plain Error, which setup keeps out of its receipt, so the move reaches it only as a classified failure.
